source: Single-festival guide, not a genre guide: FIGURES.md's canon pass does not apply. Facts are from electricforestfestival.com (pass types, festival info, prep guide, experiences, a look back, Double JJ Resort) and local news (White Lake Mirror, Oceana County Press, The Ticket 95.3, TV Overmind), all read on 4 October 2026. The official ticket page was empty and the 2027 dates were unannounced.
note: Images are Wikimedia Commons and new to this page: the entrance arch and the hammocks, both 1 July 2018 (FifthLegend, CC BY 2.0). The US festivals guide's Electric Forest image shows a different scene and is not reused. No broadcaster in selector-data.json is an Electric Forest channel and the file carries no titles to match on, so no catalogue set is verifiably recorded there. The listening block uses three sets uploaded by the artists' own YouTube channels, found by YouTube search and oEmbed-checked on 4 October 2026: Levity (_A3n8oIbwtc, 2024, about 920,000 views), Whethan (OdDOnJ-aP4k, 2025, about 460,000) and Of The Trees (-eVk7dh8dO4, 2025, about 404,000). The page says they are recorded at Electric Forest according to their upload titles, and not that they come from the catalogue.
